name: Enemy Posture System PRIVATE TEST
author: Dusklight community mods
description: PRIVATE TEST. Enemy Posture System 0.11.1 (LNK SESSION02 FIX01 on 0.11.0). Everything of 0.11.0 (Bokoblin posture, break/punish/Finish, enemy bars, Shield Attack parry +40, Link's posture bar, hidden bottom prompts, direct hits, life/guard recovery, variant weights, FIX01 stability, native Link guard break at 100) PLUS: MANUAL SHIELD (from Lazy Shield Rework 1.0.0 by Kamilink, manual shielding only, no crouch shielding): hold R while locked on to raise the shield; L alone no longer raises it; Shield Attack is R+B (parries unchanged). When Link's posture breaks, the native Guard Break plays at normal speed and then Link stays exposed for about 2.5 s in total (no shield, no Shield Attack, no backflip/sidehop/rolls; walking and sword still work); afterwards the shield needs a NEW R press. Recovery x1.5 only while really shielding. Credit: manual shield logic adapted from Kamilink's Lazy Shield Rework. Replaces 0.11.0 and older versions of this mod (same ID): never load them together, and do not load Lazy Shield Rework at the same time. Human Windows DX12 validation pending.
